champion.builds: THE BEST ELISE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Elise Top build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Electrocute as your keystone, followed by Taste of Blood, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Triumph and Coup de Grace in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Lich Bane as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Shadowflame. For your last 3 items, you should build Rabadon's Deathcap, Zhonya's Hourglass and finish with Banshee's Veil. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 66.2% winrate over 77 matches played. Optional Your second option for Elise Top build would be to take Teleport and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Press the Attack as your keystone, Absorb Life, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Demolish with Bone Plating in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Nashor's Tooth, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Shadowflame as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Zhonya's Hourglass, Lich Bane and Rabadon's Deathcap. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 63.6% win rate over 66 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Sixth Sense and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Manaflow Band with Scorch in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Stormsurge as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Shadowflame as a third item. You want to finish the build with Void Staff, Rabadon's Deathcap and Banshee's Veil. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 55.0% win rate across 60 matches played. Situational Elise Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Elise build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Elise runes page.
